import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('monthly_expense_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Expense Ledger', header=3)
# Keep rows where Transaction ID starts with EXP-
mask = df['Transaction ID'].astype(str).str.startswith('EXP-')
df2 = df[mask].copy()
# Filter
df2['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df2['Date'], errors='coerce')
cond = (
    (df2['Programme'] == 'Jal Jeevan Saathi') &
    (df2['State'] == 'Maharashtra') &
    (df2['Date'] >= '2025-04-01') &
    (df2['Date'] <= '2025-09-30')
)
filtered = df2[cond]
print('Rows found:', len(filtered))
print(filtered[['Transaction ID','Date','Programme','State','Amount (INR)']])
total = filtered['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print('Total:', total)
\""
